cases.name: discount
cases.note: Notes contain 'discount' → ScriptTask assigns `custom.normalizedtotals.gross = totals.gross * 0.9` = 1338.75. With graph.js:buildInitSetNode / seedLiteralFromSchema now seeding declared sub-schema properties (custom.normalizedtotals as {}) from the DataObject JSON Schema, the ScriptTask no longer crashes on the `.gross =` assignment — it runs cleanly. However, the Condition still routes to the fallback (Create Order) because it reads `$('Initialize Custom Data').item.json.normalizedtotals.gross` — Init's pristine state, not the mutated `$json.custom.normalizedtotals.gross` from the ScriptTask's return. So `undefined <= 10000` is false → fallback → Create Order. Send Mail is still unreachable; ratchet expectHttp/expectMail once the custom-read resolver learns to route through `$json.custom` (or a downstream write-back mechanism) after a mutating predecessor.
